# getstream_channel_type (Resource)

Manage a GetStream.io channel type and its configuration.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "getstream_channel_type" "messaging" {
  name = "messaging"

  # Feature toggles (unset fields inherit the GetStream.io server defaults).
  typing_events      = true
  read_events        = true
  reactions          = true
  replies            = true
  uploads            = true
  push_notifications = true

  max_message_length = 5000
  message_retention  = "infinite"

  automod          = "disabled"
  automod_behavior = "flag"

  commands = ["giphy"]

  grants = {
    admin = ["create-channel", "read-channel", "update-channel"]
    user  = ["read-channel"]
  }
}

# Renaming a channel type forces replacement (destroy + create), since the name
# is the resource identifier. Import an existing type by its name:
#   terraform import getstream_channel_type.messaging messaging
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Unique name of the channel type. This is the identifier; renaming forces replacement.

### Optional

- `automod` (String) Automod mode: one of "disabled", "simple", or "AI".
- `automod_behavior` (String) Automod behavior: one of "flag" or "block".
- `blocklist` (String) Name of the blocklist applied to this channel type.
- `blocklist_behavior` (String) Blocklist behavior: one of "flag" or "block".
- `commands` (List of String) Commands enabled on the channel type (e.g. ["all"]).
- `connect_events` (Boolean) Whether connect/disconnect events are sent.
- `custom_events` (Boolean) Whether custom events are enabled.
- `grants` (Map of List of String) Permission grants, keyed by role, each a list of grant strings.
- `max_message_length` (Number) Maximum length of a message in characters.
- `message_retention` (String) Message retention: "infinite" or a numeric number of days.
- `mutes` (Boolean) Whether users can mute channels.
- `push_notifications` (Boolean) Whether push notifications are enabled.
- `reactions` (Boolean) Whether message reactions are enabled.
- `read_events` (Boolean) Whether read receipts are tracked.
- `reminders` (Boolean) Whether reminders are enabled.
- `replies` (Boolean) Whether threaded replies are enabled.
- `search` (Boolean) Whether messages are indexed for search.
- `typing_events` (Boolean) Whether typing indicator events are sent.
- `uploads` (Boolean) Whether file uploads are enabled.
- `url_enrichment` (Boolean) Whether URLs are enriched with previews.
